review.content_class_rationale: Opened the full 3870x921 JPEG (reduced-size copy viewed, plus a full-resolution crop): a three-panel composite labelled A, B and C. A is a color photograph of a cut heart specimen held in gloved hands beside a tape measure; B is a pink H&E-type microscopy field with large fat-cell-like areas between muscle bands; C is a red-purple and blue trichrome-type microscopy field. No caption or other text is embedded beyond the panel letters and tape numerals.

ownership_evidence.quote: The epicardial fat thickness of right ventricle was 4–5 mm and infiltrating into the myocardium (Figure S1(A)).

Histology revealed significant replacement of myocardial tissue of the right ventricle with fibro-fatty tissue in haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) (Figure S1(B)) and Masson's trichrome stains (Figure S1(C)).

review.notes: Gross heart photograph and two histology fields. The content matches the single index patient autopsy findings cited in the case history as Figure S1(A), (B) and (C), but nothing in the source literally links this file to those citations (no supplement cross-reference or caption), so ownership is unresolved and the file is not includable; it would be includable as a still image of p1 if ownership were resolved. The citation quotes are kept as context only. The sibling supplement visual sidecar also keeps panel ownership unresolved.
